description: The dashboard unit and window tests run the branch of the dashboard task router that their command word selects: the Cargo packages that branch and the package lists it mentions name (test targets and path-dependency closure included) and the TypeScript tests it runs (import closure), plus bun's start-up reads and the schema and fixtures of the dashboard. Never the build library, the compiler or the rest of the dashboard tree that `reads` and `^default` stand for.
